R2 is the closest alternative but overreads the 2002 micro-invasive cancer as recurrence despite the long interval and low recurrence risk. R1 and R5 explain only the cecal mass/fistula or lymphadenopathy/LDH and ignore the vaginal origin and gynecologic history.
